title: Yummy Alsatian Gruyere Wrap
description: A winey, cheese‑pull brunch dish that folds creamy Gruyère with sweet plum sauce into steamed Swiss chard leaves, served on a salt block for a touch of elegance.
instructions: Steam the chard leaves for 2 minutes until pliable, then set aside on a clean towel to cool slightly.
Thinly slice the Gruyère into strips that are long enough to wrap around the leaf.
Heat olive oil in a small saucepan over medium heat and add diced shallot, sautéing until translucent.
Add minced garlic to the pan, cooking for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in white wine and simmer for 1 minute to reduce slightly before adding plum sauce.
Stir the plum sauce mixture until it coats the onions and garlic, then season with salt and pepper.
Place a strip of Gruyère on each leaf, then spoon a generous amount of the plum sauce mixture over the cheese.
Fold the leaf over the filling, tucking the sides to seal the wrap, and place each on the salt block to keep temperature steady.
Serve immediately, allowing the salt block to provide a subtle mineral flavor that complements the winey sauce.
Enjoy the creamy pull of the cheese and the sweet tang of plum sauce in every bite.
